sourceFacts./scope: Version-1.2 draft of the Moriarty Cardano property catalogue. Carries all 143 v1.1 rows (including the 137 v1 rows and the 80 v0 rows) byte-identically under MCJ/1 with the same 89 current heads; no row is added, removed, renamed or re-versioned, so every row and predicate digest is unchanged. The edition records the review fdecbe41 checker repairs (consumer-declared audit grants, full-match typing, typed nested members) in its schema descriptions. Research vocabulary and typed statement source for a UNIT checker only. Row count is not an exhaustiveness or coverage claim. No row is a bridge row. Mutable status prose lives in the non-digested NOTES file.

/lineage.rowCarriage: all 143 v1.1 rows carried byte-identically in v1.1 order; 89 current heads; no added, removed, renamed or re-versioned row; every row_digest and predicate_digest equals the v1.1 manifest's; introducedIn keeps the edition that first carried each row

renames.note: members v11Base and lineage added; every other member keeps its v1.1 shape
bundles naming this edition carry catalogue_version 1.2-draft-20261015; a 1.1 document stays readable as a legacy edition, validated only under the repaired rules

renames.to: moriarty-cardano-consumer-policy/2 (accepted_auditors = consumer-declared grants {auditor_id, report_sha256, verdict, scopes, covers_vk_digests, predicate_refs})
renames.note: policy /1 remains valid only with accepted_auditors == []; a non-empty /1 list is refused (CTX_POLICY_SCHEMA), never reinterpreted

unchanged.identity: MCJ/1; mcj.py byte-identical to v1.1; a scoped profile with no full RFC 8785 claim
moriarty-cardano-admission-record/1.1; audit_refs keep their shape and earn credit only via consumer grants

unchanged.item: profiles, vocabularies, semantic table, setup classes, identity layers, pattern inventory and families

repairs.summary: audit credit = record scopes intersected with consumer grant scopes, only where the grant covers the record's vk_digest and predicate_ref; consumer dispute grants refuse whether or not the record cites them; uncited grants and ungranted refs count for nothing; the deny-list is kept
every typed string validated by re.fullmatch over ASCII-only classes; decimal strings length-bounded; predicate refs typed as versioned ids; pinned content compared by MCJ/1 bytes (true is not 1)
lint and pattern-family checks iterate only type-validated containers; every document member typed; no library exception for MCJ-valid input; CLI stdout is ASCII JSON

notClaimed: no row of the bridge's missing 42 Cardano / 52 Midnight catalogues is recovered, renamed or reconstructed; MCP ids remain a separate namespace
no proof, VK, setup, signature, audit, ledger state or deployment is verified; grants and audit references are unsigned declarations
no full RFC 8785 conformance, no cryptographic authentication and no ledger truth
rows are an inventory, not approved predicates; all 20 pattern families remain open
universal certificates, execution claims and authenticated-ledger claims stay distinct claim kinds; no unverified relation becomes admitted
